When did we forget our dreams?
When I was a boy I had a dream It never came true But somehow it seems When I drift away and I know it's so There's a certain time and place I go https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=008SHKg5ThM

For me, I wanted to be a sumo wrestler. Then, I gave up on those childish dreams and wanted to be the guy who rides on the back of the garbage truck. Then, I wanted to be a construction worker, but mostly to drive the heavy equipment. Then, around 12, it was a toss up between engineering and a USAF pilot. Sometime, around high school or so, I gave up on the Air Force idea, then quickly dropped the engineer dream as well. So, if you count flying, then high school was when I forgot my dreams. If you go by utterly ridiculous, then the sumo wrestler thing ended when I was about 6. But I did wind up getting fat, so maybe the dream is still alive!
When life got comfortable enough, chasing that dream became more of a chore than staying where I am.

I haven't forgotten my dreams. They've just been on hold while life took the turns it chose. I'm finally back to a point where I can do something to fulfill them. It's probably my last shot at making them come true so I'm going to give it all I can.
